name: RetentionCompliancePolicyTemplate
label: Retention Compliance Policy Template
helpText: Deploy Microsoft Purview retention compliance policies from CIPP templates. Existing policies and rules are overwritten in place.
executiveText: Deploys retention policies that govern how long content is preserved in Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams. Enforces consistent compliance retention across tenants for regulatory and legal hold needs.
docsDescription: Deploy Microsoft Purview retention compliance policies from CIPP templates. If a policy or rule with the same name already exists in the tenant, it is updated in place; otherwise it is created. Uses the application token to bypass GDAP delegated-identity restrictions on retention cmdlets. The standard grades whether each selected policy exists by name - it does not diff policy settings - and rewrites every selected policy on each remediation run, matching the classic standard.
